headline: Denison Mines Reports Q3 2026 Results and Phoenix ISR Project Progress
summary: Denison Mines Corp. filed its Q3 2026 financial results, reporting 24% completion of full-scale construction at its Phoenix ISR uranium mine.
why: Denison Mines is a uranium exploration and development company focused on projects in the Athabasca Basin of Canada. Uranium mining projects are capital-intensive and subject to long-term development timelines.

impacts.name: Denison Mines Corp.
impacts.why: The company reported financial results and construction progress for its primary asset.
